strings.name: Shigeru Ishiba
strings.role: Politician · Former prime minister of Japan
strings.summary: Raised in Tottori, Ishiba entered banking after Keio and parliament in 1986. He worked on defense, agriculture and regional revitalization, leaving and later rejoining the LDP. Prime minister from 2024, he faced election setbacks and party pressure before leaving office in 2025. He continues parliamentary and regional diplomatic activity.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His long defense and ruling-party career, including government leadership, influences national-security and regional-revitalization debates.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth and upbringing
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in 1957 and raised in Tottori Prefecture.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and beginnings
strings.facts.f2.value: Keio law graduate; joined Mitsui Bank in 1979.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Defense policy experience
strings.highlights.h1.text: Served as Defense Agency chief and defense minister.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Regional revitalization
strings.highlights.h2.text: As the first responsible minister, addressed population and regional development.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Visits Seoul
strings.timeline.t1.text: Met South Korean Prime Minister Han Seongsook.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Premiership ends
strings.timeline.t2.text: Sanae Takaichi succeeded him as prime minister.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becomes prime minister
strings.timeline.t3.text: Won party leadership on his fifth attempt and received parliamentary designation.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Regional revitalization
strings.timeline.t4.text: Became the first minister responsible for this policy.
strings.timeline.t5.title: First cabinet appointment
strings.timeline.t5.text: Led the Defense Agency and worked on security legislation.
strings.timeline.t6.title: First elected to parliament
strings.timeline.t7.title: Banking career
strings.timeline.t7.text: Joined Mitsui Bank after university graduation.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Moves to Tokyo
strings.timeline.t8.text: Left Tottori to attend Keio Senior High School.
